verdict.rationale: Ironclad documents a broad API: Records and Workflows APIs to create and retrieve records and workflows, approval control, contract document read/write, data exports, bulk launch, and full webhook CRUD, with webhooks manageable in both the UI and the API. However, the docs show some core tasks remain UI-only, such as designing and publishing workflows in Workflow Designer, and API access requires a separate add-on. Missing for 10: any stated UI/API parity guarantee, API-based workflow/template design and publishing, coverage of admin and configuration functions, and independent hands-on confirmation of breadth.
